front.title: Export of Microburst Information in IP Flow Information Export

abstract.t:
A microburst is a phenomenon in which arriving traffic exceeds the service capacity of an egress interface within a short period of time, causing queue occupancy to rise rapidly. It may result in transient queuing and packet loss even when the average link utilization is low, and is therefore difficult to detect through low- frequency interface statistics.
This document defines a set of IPFIX Information Elements for exporting aggregated microburst statistics per egress interface, egress queue, and measurement window. Network operators can use these statistics to identify interfaces and queues where microbursts occur frequently, and apply the results to capacity planning, QoS optimization, and the remediation of critical links.
This document does not specify microburst detection algorithms, threshold selection methods, or remediation policies.
